## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:access`, into `pm:queue`. A locked outline mark, no dialog

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T07:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** the free-plan environment list's only primary button opens a paywall dialog, against a rule the maintainer accepted (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 3 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2775). Every free-plan owner meets it first.
- **Direction, as the card says:**
  - The `upgrade_for_development` branch of `EnvironmentListToolbar` renders an outline, locked mark that links to the entitlement summary's `upgradeUrl`.
  - The `?runAction=create_environment` deep link stops opening the dialog too.
  - Strings go in all ten locales, and the tier label matches cloud's 「团队版起」.
  - ⛔ No dialog.
- **Delivery:** this reaches cloud only with cloud's v18 framework move (the pin-pair boundary `e5311165a8` on objectstack-ai/cloud#2709). That is ordering, not a block. `Clause-②: no`.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (as triage `6120128546` directs: the `upgrade_for_development` branch draws an outline, locked mark linking to the entitlement summary's `upgradeUrl`, the `?runAction=create_environment` deep link stops opening the dialog too, ⛔ no dialog)

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12190`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface, on objectui `main` `9646e2e`:
- **The toolbar:** `packages/app-shell/src/environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx`. The `upgrade_for_development` branch (the primary `environment-add-upgrade` button) and the `autoRunCreate` effect, both of which call `onUpgrade(upgradeDialogSpec(...))` today.
- **The helper:** `packages/app-shell/src/environment/entitlements.ts`, only where `upgradeDialogSpec` loses its last caller. The reactive refusal dialog (`upgradeCta`) is measured and reported, ⛔ not changed.
- **Strings:** `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, all ten packs, for the locked mark.
- Co-located tests under `packages/app-shell/src/environment/__tests__/`.
- `.changeset/12190-env-list-locked-mark.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`; ⛔ never `major`).
- ⛔ No change to `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts` or `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/` (objectui#12197 waits for this card), and none to the layout files (objectui#12201, this round).
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: `objectui's environment list toolbar (@object-ui/app-shell EnvironmentListToolbar), whose upgrade_for_development branch renders the page's only primary button as a paywall-dialog opener | cloud's own paid points already moved to inline marks (objectstack-ai/cloud#2784), and the entitlement summary already carries upgradeUrl | every free-plan organization owner opening the environment list (staging screenshot on cloud branch design-assets/cloud-console-2026-10, commit fdd422db)`
Thread-read: 6120128546
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T08:58Z on objectui `main` `9646e2e`:
- **The toolbar:** its last change on `main` is `31987bd` (landed). No open PR touches `packages/app-shell/src/environment/` (7 open PRs read).
- **Locale packs:** open PRs objectui#12203 and objectui#12209 also edit them. That is ordinary concurrency.
- **Serial after this card:** objectui#12197 (queued, p2) draws the same plan-tier label and works next to the entitlements hook. It waits for this card, and the wording question is recorded on it.
- **Seat 1's in-flight cards** declare no `environment/` file. Epic objectui#7611's territory does not include it.

Cloud seat (from the maintainer's session, 2026-10-12), on the plan-tier label the dev is making reusable: **「团队版起」** is right. The plan's zh name is 「团队版」 in cloud's bundle (`zh-CN.ts:76`) and on the pricing page (「升级到团队版」); 「Team 版起」 in objectui#12197 / cloud#2775 / cloud#2777 was the cloud seat's shorthand and is corrected there. Compose the key from the plan label (`<plan label> + 起`) rather than hard-coding 「团队版」, so a Business-tier capability renders 「商业版起」 from the same key. Full note on objectui#12197. ⛔ Not a claim.

## File-surface amendment, patch round 2 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd` · 2026-10-12T10:13Z

Amends claim `6121025853`; same session, branch and PR (objectui#12223). ⛔ Not a new claim.

The round-1 report (`6122160275`) asked whether to retire the toolbar's now-dead `onUpgrade` prop, which edits a file outside the claim. Verdict: option A. The surface grows, region by region, to exactly these:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`: only the `onUpgrade` attribute on the `EnvironmentListToolbar` element, the stale "or an upgrade prompt" comment above `environmentEntitlements`, and any local those leave unused. The `ManagedByBadge` site in the same file belongs to objectui#12194 (this seat, in flight). The regions are disjoint, so whichever PR lands second merges `main`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx`: the `onUpgrade` prop itself.
- Comment-only edits in `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, the `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog.tsx` header and `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts`, so no comment describes the retired proactive dialog. The round-1 ban on `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts` existed for objectui#12197, which the maintainer has since put on hold (`6122029254`).

No behaviour change beyond round 1. The contract-tier review runs on the head this round produces.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12223 (head `0a13049`) · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd` · 2026-10-12T11:17Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report. Claim `6121025853` and amendment `6122200077`; reports `6122160275`, `6122499354` and `6122783782`. - **Landing:** ready first, then auto-merge once `mergeable_state` settles, through the merge queue.
